method.ordering: alternating; odd rounds baseline first, even rounds candidate first
method.aaNoiseControl: the released baseline tree runs twice per round at every record count; that difference is the noise floor

memoryMethod.maxRSS: process.resourceUsage().maxRSS raw value; whole child high-water mark, includes imports and fixture setup
memoryMethod.replaySamples: process.memoryUsage() taken by a temporary instrumented copy of domain-storage.js after the plan is built, every 1024 absorbed lines, and after the commit; uncollected heap gauges showing where the peak occurs
memoryMethod.planRetention: --plan-worker builds the plan in a child without opening the domain, then global.gc() twice and subtracts the same measurement taken before; that delta is retained, not a high-water mark
